name: feature.destination-sync.nodes
description: Destination Sync (CDP-D) — the `prepare` verb over ctx.features['destination-sync']: CDC-filter a record set against the sync's watermark and field-map each into destination payloads (advancing the cursor), so a downstream core.openwop.http.fetch (fanned out per payload) does the SSRF-guarded egress. No bespoke sender — egress rides the existing http node (ruling #3).
author: openwop

nodes.label: Destination Sync Prepare
nodes.description: CDC-filter + field-map a record set for a configured destination sync; outputs { payloads, count, nextCursor? } for a downstream core.openwop.http.fetch (per-payload fan-out) to egress. Advances the sync watermark so a re-run sends only changed records. Inputs: { syncId, records }.

nodes.label: Destination Sync Prepare Onward (OpenWOP host)
nodes.description: ADR 0289 / RFC 0128 G4 — for an 'openwop-host' sync, build the onward OpenWOP envelopes carrying the re-emitted permittedPurposes label (⊆ received, never-widen, []-drop) and flatten envelopes[0] onto { onwardBody, peerIngestUrl } so a single downstream core.openwop.http.fetch POSTs it to the peer's trigger-bridge ingest. Outputs { envelopes, onwardBody, peerIngestUrl, count, dropped, nextCursor?, connectionId? }. Flag-gated: honest-off when purpose propagation is disabled. Inputs: { syncId, records }.

nodes.label: Destination Sync Warehouse Load (reverse-ETL BigQuery)
nodes.description: ADR 0292 / CDP-D §6 — for a 'warehouse' sync, run the GOVERNED reverse-ETL BigQuery tabledata.insertAll over ctx.features['destination-sync'].warehouseLoad. Gated by actionPolicyOf('warehouse.load') (default approval-required, fail-closed): disabled → refuse; draft-only → dry-run the rows that WOULD load (loaded:0); approval-required/unset → mint-or-consult a warehouse-load approval and insert ONLY when approved. Deterministic per-row insertId dedups a replay/:fork. Surfaces the gate verdict as the node status (loaded | requires_approval | draft_run | disabled | no_connection | failed). Outputs carry counts + per-row failure reasons — NEVER row bodies (subject data) or credentials. Inputs: { syncId, records }.
